title: Heart & Haven Care | Healthcare Services Platform
description: Developed a comprehensive healthcare services platform for Heart & Haven Care using React and Next.js, featuring three core service areas: Domiciliary Care, Temporary Staffing, and Supported Living. Built with a strong focus on performance, accessibility, and search visibility to showcase compassionate care services. Delivered a clean, responsive layout using modular, reusable components to present service offerings, care features (Hourly Visiting, Live In, 24h Service), compliance standards (CQC registration), and clear lead-generation calls to action. Optimized the application for fast load times through efficient asset handling, code splitting, and SEO-friendly meta structure. Ensured consistent styling across all screen sizes and built a scalable frontend foundation that supports future content growth and feature expansion.
overview: A modern healthcare services platform built with React and Next.js, showcasing domiciliary care, temporary staffing, and supported living services with focus on performance, accessibility, and SEO optimization.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: A modern analytics dashboard built with React and TypeScript, featuring real-time data visualization, customizable widgets, and advanced filtering capabilities. The dashboard helps businesses track KPIs, analyze trends, and make data-driven decisions through an intuitive and responsive interface.
overview: A sleek and modern personal portfolio website to showcase skills, projects, and resume.
